role: Records, per overworld chunk, the server tickCounter at which ChunkProviderServer.unloadQueuedChunks saved it, so a whole-server replay restores each chunk's pending tile ticks with the same clock the unload save used (the save runs before incrementTotalWorldTime).
used_by: csrc/engine/serverreplay.c serverreplay_load (parses unloadClock; sr_ensure_saved uses each chunk's own clock)
notes: Always on. Dimension 0 only. Static TreeMap keyed by chunkXZ2Int, so dump order is key order, not the unload order. DEVLOG (around line 65-80) records the fix: the death recordings were re-recorded with it. Which test_snapshots recordings carry the field was not verified.
